bio: It sounds like the title of a song from the 1980s. This young and relaxed restaurant facing the sea offers marine-inspired cuisine, with a mouthwatering choice of shellfish, fish, and of course oysters: the establishment belongs to the Gillardeau family, the famous oyster farmers. The large terrace offers a lovely view, with the Île d'Oléron on the horizon. As for accommodation, Dormir sur la Plage has four large very well-appointed junior suites....
